_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Summarise the page I am on
scenarios.description: Read the page in front of me and answer. Do not log in anywhere, do not send anything.

scenarios.label: Fill forms from my notes
scenarios.description: Read the page and type into it for me.

scenarios.label: Watch a page for me
scenarios.description: Check a page on a schedule and tell me when it changes.

scenarios.label: Log in and act as me
scenarios.description: Use my sessions to act in my accounts through the browser.

scenarios.label: An autonomous browsing task
scenarios.description: Browse, log in and complete a task while I am away.

scenarios.label: Read-only research, no logins
scenarios.description: Read many pages; never log in, never submit.
